svg.aria-label: An isometric bench. Four hoppers feed one drum under a stamp; a reader head runs on a rail beside it; a gauge reads risk out of 100 with three lamps at its foot; a card slides along four stations to a barrier; a letterbox at the back takes a sheet from a tray; a nine-jack panel, a three-drawer cabinet, a hand press over a ledger card and a watcher with three windows sit along the front; a ruler with sixty ticks runs along the edge; a blank mount pad waits at the far right.
